title: McCasland as Pentagon director of special programs overseeing acquisition SAPs
place_text: Pentagon, Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology and Logistics

tellings.quote: From June 2009 to May 2011, McCasslin served as director of special programs at the Pentagon [music] in the office of the under secretary of defense for acquisitions, technology, and logistics.

plain: From June 2009 to May 2011, an Air Force officer named Neil McCasland is said to have been director of special programs in the Pentagon office that buys weapons and technology for the military. That put him over special access programs, the most secret and tightly restricted military projects. Michels tells this himself in an episode about missing scientists, citing McCasland's official Air Force biography, Pentagon training papers and Wikipedia, as a way of showing how close McCasland stood to the government's most hidden work.
